mentions.name: Zo
mentions.description: A self-hosted personal cloud computer combining a note-taking app, cloud drive, and AI assistant, all running on a server the user owns. Users can vibe-code apps inside the notebook using its underlying filesystem and serve those apps to the public. Still early stage and seeking feedback.
mentions.source_excerpt: Working on a combination note-taking app, cloud drive, and AI assistant, all on a server you own. You can vibe-code apps in your notebook, use your notebook's underlying filesystem, and serve apps to the public, all from your new cloud computer. Still early, but would love feedback!
